feeds.title: Vital Rangers
feeds.description: Vital Ranger is a part of the Vital Football network. Read Rangers Football News, Transfers, Opinion, and fan culture on the Vital Rangers website covering everything about Rangers and giving you the latest updates with original opinions from Gavin Kelly and Graeme Hanna.

feeds.title: Rangers News Feed
feeds.description: Rangersnewsfeed.com brings you a continuous feed of Rangers news as and when it happens from a wide range of major media sites and blogs

feeds.title: Four Lads Had A Dream Blog
feeds.description: The idea of the Four Lads Had A Dream site is to discuss all things Rangers FC. This site will give you regular opinion articles & latest Rangers news, as well as official Rangers, match day & press access.

feeds.title: Ibrox Noise
feeds.description: Ibroxnoise.co.uk has been running since late 2011 as an unofficial fan site for news, views, and general Rangers discussion. We consider ourselves an 'aggregation' site for Rangers fans, which is a one-stop news, analysis, speculation, and transfer rumors site, with the occasional scoop thrown in.Ibrox Noise has found a global audience and the readership has increased almost exponentially, and we are proud of the community we've started to build.

feeds.title: Rangers FC News Blog
feeds.description: Rangers FC News was launched in 2007 to provide a central, dedicated unofficial source for Rangers fans to visit to see the news all about Glasgow Rangers aggregated from many quality worldwide media outlets and blogs.
